blocks.intro: In older buildings, the toilet often sits on an old flange over someone else's ceiling.

items.body: A failed wax seal can stain the ceiling downstairs.
Old flanges corrode, so the toilet won't stay tight.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: When a toilet leaks on an upper floor, the first sign is usually a stain on the neighbor's ceiling. A failed wax ring, a cracked tank or a loose supply connection can all cause it. We check each one, reset the toilet on a new seal and test it. If the flange is damaged, we repair it so the toilet stays tight. It's a quick fix that prevents a much bigger one.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of Toilet Work
blocks.body: Small repairs are quick. Resetting a toilet or replacing a corroded flange takes longer. Carrying a new toilet up several flights adds a little time. We check and quote a flat price.

blocks.h2: Toilet Questions From Lincoln Park Homeowners

items.q: My neighbor says water is coming from my bathroom. Is it the toilet?
items.answer: Often. A failed wax seal can leak through the floor without showing on yours. We check it first.

items.q: Why does my toilet keep running?
items.answer: Usually a worn flapper or fill valve.

items.q: Can you fix a toilet that rocks?
items.answer: Yes. We tighten or replace bolts and repair the flange, then reset the toilet with a new seal.

items.q: Can you install a compact toilet in a small bath?
items.answer: Yes. Compact and wall-hung models can save space.

items.q: Does replacing a toilet need association approval?
items.answer: Usually not, but check your rules for work hours.

items.q: Why does my toilet run after the upstairs unit flushes?
items.answer: Usually it's a worn flapper in your own toilet. Pressure changes can make it more noticeable.

items.q: How much does toilet repair cost in Lincoln Park?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on what's wrong and whether you're repairing or replacing. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
